headline: Full-time employment reaches 78.6 %, but several groups are hidden for this small sample.
how_to_read: Left: all respondents; middle: employed versus not employed; right: the detailed situation. Band widths show each group's share of respondents. The hatched 'Hidden' flow marks groups with fewer than 3 people, whose values are not shown.
key_findings: Nobody reports other employment, not seeking work, studying or another situation (0.0 % each).
Total employment, part-time, self-employment, seeking work and retirement are hidden (fewer than 3 people).
benchmark: Full-time employment is 4.4 pp above the European region (74.2 %) and 3.7 pp above all schools (74.9 %). The overall employment rate cannot be compared, as the school's own value is hidden.
caveats: With n = 28, each person shifts percentages by several points, and the hidden cells limit comparison.
